download_response_satisfaction_model: download the SumMem-MSC 3B FiD-RAG response satisfaction model to the specified datapath directory
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the response satisfaction model if not already built
check_model_built: check if the response satisfaction model is already built before downloading using the built function
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the fits response satisfaction model using get_model_dir
download_models_with_options: download models using ParlAI download_models with datapath and model type options
